verifications.source_locator: Results, 'Fibrogenic shift driven by mesenchymal state transition' section, near Figure 3A (p.1153-1154)
verifications.source_context: accompanied by upregulation of myofibroblast markers α-SMA (ACTA2) and TAGLN (Figure 3A); gene signature scoring confirmed enrichment of myofibroblast markers within fibroblast subtypes and VSM cells in ACR.
verifications.reason: Author explicitly labels ACTA2 as a myofibroblast marker and uses myofibroblast marker gene signatures to classify/score the myofibroblast state in fibroblast and VSM cells; the previous scope-based exclusion is not valid under the current policy.

verifications.source_context: accompanied by upregulation of myofibroblast markers α-SMA (ACTA2) and TAGLN (Figure 3A); gene signature scoring confirmed enrichment of myofibroblast markers within fibroblast subtypes and VSM cells in ACR.

verifications.source_locator: Results, 'IFN-γ-mediated signaling and inflammation in ACR' section (p.1155)
verifications.source_context: IF analysis ... revealed decreased pSTAT1+ cells specifically within VE-Cadherin+ cells ... VE-cadherin expression was reduced in ACR, consistent with IFN-γ-mediated endothelial injury and adherens junction disruption.
verifications.reason: VE-Cadherin (CDH5) is used to define VE-Cadherin+ cells as the endothelial cell population in immunofluorescence and to assess endothelial injury, satisfying marker identity and identification/classification use. The previous scope-based exclusion is invalid.

verifications.source_context: Percentage of cells positive for COL3A1 (TGF-β-induced collagen), p-S6RP (mTOR activation marker), and double-positive cells (COL3A1+/p-S6RP+).
verifications.reason: p-S6RP is a phospho-protein modification marker of mTOR pathway activation, not a gene entity, and it is used for post-annotation immunofluorescence validation rather than cell-type annotation.

verifications.source_context: COL3A1+ cells showed significant enrichment in ACR (36.0%, OR 3.0, 95% CI 2.8–3.2) and Resolved samples (44.4%, OR 4.4, 95% CI 3.8–5.2) compared to Never (16.5%). Table 3 lists COL3A1 as a marker in mixed-effects logistic regression.
verifications.reason: COL3A1 is used as a marker of TGF-β-induced collagen-producing cells for immunofluorescence quantification and statistical modeling, not for identifying, naming, or classifying cell clusters; it is post-annotation functional validation.

issues.description: The paper reports 59 unique scRNA-seq clusters but does not enumerate the final cell-type annotation labels; annotation_labels in cluster_inventory is set to 59 as an assumption, though some clusters may share a cell-type label.
scATAC-seq cluster count is not reported in the text; no specific cluster labels or marker genes are available from the ATAC analysis in the Markdown.

Cell-type marker information is stated to be available in Supplemental Table 3 and the Lung AlloMap portal, but these are not reproduced in the Markdown, so no additional specific gene-cell marker pairs could be verified from those resources.

No L4 neuroendocrine cells or neuroendocrine markers are described in this lung allograft study; all re-evaluated markers fall outside the original L4 target scope, consistent with the scope-neutral review policy.
